integrity: Analytic argument and standalone numerical corroboration supplied; no human or independent audit or machine formal certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The exact joint law concerns independent surface-area-uniform points on S^2 with an independently randomized signed plane normal, and depends on a threshold-dependent mark. The scalar volume distribution is classical from Miles (1971), and a prior joint weak-limit theorem covers the unmarked conditional shape; the present result concerns the exact finite-threshold marked representation and sharp total-variation rate. Original 1971 and 1980 primary full texts remained unavailable, so priority remains provisional.
title: An exact conditional coplanarity law and a sharp nonanalytic correction for sphere-inscribed tetrahedra
